cohort: The study included 395 singleton live births following in vitro fertilization from one university-affiliated hospital between 2009-2017, after excluding cases with a history of miscarriage, abnormal uterine cavity, previous uterine surgery, specific IVF cycle types, or multiple pregnancies.
finding: Multiparity was significantly associated with delayed villous maturation, while primiparity was significantly associated with maternal vascular malperfusion in placental histopathology.
